scope: PowerPoint-native narration recording plus the intended Meshy-to-Mixamo native-3D presenter path
decision: Freeze the talking-head worker as the resale-safe baseline. The production native-3D route is exclusively Meshy generation followed by the approved Mixamo rig/animation path and native PowerPoint 3D packaging; the self-hosted TRELLIS.2/UniRig/DRTK route is retained only for proof-of-concept and flow testing, not as the production 3D provider.

talkingHeadPipeline.policy: original user uploads remain authoritative; body branch may be original or alpha-only; face branch is dedicated original or deterministic crop/pad/resize

talkingHeadPipeline.provenance: pinned source commit and model hashes

talkingHeadPipeline.license: MIT plus upstream commercial-use statement for the selected checkpoint

talkingHeadPipeline.policy: no GFPGAN, CodeFormer, RestoreFormer++, or other face-restoration dependency in the frozen worker
repair-free package and playback contract required

native3dProductionPath.provider: Meshy image-to-3D → Mixamo rig/animation → native PowerPoint 3D
native3dProductionPath.policy: Meshy and Mixamo are the only intended production 3D components; body-only/original identity policy, provider terms, owner worksheet, live A/B, attribution, and resale review must pass before production enablement

native3dProofOfConceptPath.provider: self-hosted TRELLIS.2 + UniRig + DRTK permissive export path
native3dProofOfConceptPath.policy: Permissive path may validate compiler, packaging, fallback, and playback flows but must not be represented as the production 3D provider or used to close Meshy/Mixamo clearance

optionalNotInBaseline.reason: the intended production 3D path; external account/terms, owner worksheet, live A/B, Mixamo attribution, and resale review remain open
candidate only; no selected weight is deployed or relied upon for commercial clearance; GFPGAN path is prohibited
separate code/weight/training-data provenance and mouth-mask/temporal tests required
